## Feature Description

What feature would you like to see?

## Use Case

What problem does this solve? Who would benefit from it?

## Example

How would you expect to use this feature? Provide an example tool call:

```json
{
  "tool": "generate_invoice",
  "args": {
    "your_new_field": "example value"
  }
}
```

## Alternatives Considered

Any workarounds you're currently using or alternatives you've considered?

## Additional Context

Links to relevant specs, examples, or prior art. If this is a pretext-pdf core feature request, consider opening an issue there instead: https://github.com/Himaan1998Y/pretext-pdf/issues
